site.name: Elsie Mine
overview: Elsie Mine is a documented historic tungsten mine in Boulder County's Tungsten district.

Federal exploration-assistance records list the Elsie Mine under two DMEA dockets, while early Colorado tungsten reporting and USGS-derived mapping preserve the site as a distinct named mine locality.

timeline.text: Colorado's early tungsten survey illustrated ore from the Elsie Mine while documenting the main tungsten area of Boulder County.
USGS Data Series 1004 preserves two DMEA exploration-assistance files for the Elsie Mine, docket numbers 3538 and 3785, both identified with tungsten.

moreHistory: The Colorado Geological Survey's early report on Boulder County tungsten includes Elsie Mine ore in its illustrated discussion of the district, confirming the mine's historic identity within the tungsten field.
USGS Data Series 1004 independently preserves two federal exploration-assistance files for the Elsie Mine, strengthening the identification beyond a single mapped-name lead.

USGS-derived place mapping places the Elsie Mine at approximately 39.9419314, -105.4883303. Remnant uses this as a mine-locality identification point and does not claim it is a field-surveyed surviving shaft or portal.
